en: A colorized postcard view of a landscaped urban park with a central octagonal bandstand or gazebo surrounded by trees, flowerbeds, white benches, and lampposts. Pathways lead toward the structure from the foreground, where more benches line the walkway. Low buildings with red roofs are visible beyond the greenery. Spanish and English captions identifying the scene and its location are printed in the image border, along with a postcard number.
